description: This file defines a command-line interface for running a gateway server, including options parsing, configuration loading, error handling, and startup logic for the gateway component of the system.

methods.name: warnInlinePasswordFlag
methods.description: Logs a warning about insecure password usage via command line.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPasswordOption
methods.description: Resolves the gateway password from options, either directly or from a file.

methods.name: parseEnumOption
methods.description: Parses a string option against allowed enum values.

methods.name: formatModeChoices
methods.description: Formats allowed mode choices for display.

methods.name: formatModeErrorList
methods.description: Formats a list of mode options for error messages.

methods.name: maybeLogPendingControlUiBuild
methods.description: Logs info if the control UI assets are missing, suggesting a build.

methods.name: getGatewayStartGuardErrors
methods.description: Checks configuration and state to determine if gateway start should be blocked.

methods.name: resolveGatewayRunOptions
methods.description: Resolves and inherits command options for gateway run command.

methods.name: isGatewayLockError
methods.description: Type guard to identify GatewayLockError instances.

methods.name: isHealthyGatewayLockError
methods.description: Checks if a GatewayLockError indicates a healthy lock state.

methods.name: runGatewayCommand
methods.description: Main function to initialize and start the gateway server with error handling and configuration.

methods.name: addGatewayRunCommand
methods.description: Adds CLI options and command handler for the gateway run command.
